description: Python archetype. Covers uv/pep621 pyproject repos, pip-tools/requirements repos, and plain pip across subdirs. uv is handled by the pep621 + pip-compile managers (there is no separate 'uv' manager). Managers auto-detected; this preset only groups.

packageRules.description: Group dev-tooling (linters/formatters/type-checkers) separately from runtime deps. Repos that pin these manually can disable via matchDepNames in their own renovate.json.
